threats.title: THREAT-09 Resource exhaustion
threats.description: Authenticated staff floods costly graph-solving scenarios or clients flood search. Unbounded child processes would exhaust host resources. R-09 / TVA-09 / A-02; A-04; A-08 Status: Local controls tested; distributed/OS resource isolation pending
threats.mitigation: Rate/body limits; staff-only solver; 5000 steps, 25000 edges, 50000 memberships, 2 MiB body; two Python workers, five-second timeout, 8 MiB output ceiling. No OS memory sandbox. ACL-09 / SEC-09

threats.title: THREAT-01 SQL injection
threats.description: If search concatenates input, a crafted query can bypass record filtering and disclose nonpublic research metadata. Successful SQL injection depends on the actual query and database grants. R-01 / TVA-01 / A-02 Status: Implemented locally; residual assumptions require human review
threats.mitigation: Parameterized search and publication filtering; synthetic exploit comparison and regression tests pass. ACL-01 / SEC-01

threats.title: THREAT-02 Object authorization bypass
threats.description: A user changes a record ID and reads another research team’s nonpublic record or service request. Client-hidden links do not enforce authorization. R-02 / TVA-02 / A-02; A-03 Status: Implemented locally; service workflow persistence proposed
threats.mitigation: Owner-or-staff predicates on records; default denial; cross-user tests pass. Collaborator grants are not implemented. ACL-02 / SEC-02

threats.title: THREAT-07 Unsafe document processing
threats.description: If uploads are enabled, a malicious file exploits a vulnerable parser or unsafe execution path, giving a runtime foothold. A PDF extension or polyglot alone does not execute code. R-07 / TVA-07 / A-02 Status: Avoided in current scope; proposed feature risk
threats.mitigation: No upload or attachment parsing endpoint; defer until isolated parser security is reviewed. ACL-07 / SEC-07

threats.title: THREAT-10 Stored browser script
threats.description: Stored content executes when another user views a record. It may perform same-origin actions; HttpOnly cookies cannot be read directly by script. R-10 / TVA-10 / A-02; A-01 Status: Future frontend sink must be reviewed
threats.mitigation: JSON-only API with no HTML rendering frontend; safe output rendering required for future UI. ACL-10 / SEC-10

threats.title: THREAT-05 Missing database isolation
threats.description: A missed application permission check exposes rows across research groups. Missing RLS is a defense gap, not by itself proof that a user can query the database. R-05 / TVA-05 / A-02 Status: Partial defense; missed future query checks remain a risk
threats.mitigation: Non-owner runtime and tested application predicates; RLS not implemented. ACL-05 / SEC-05

threats.title: THREAT-08 Database extortion
threats.description: An attacker reaches the DB, gains sufficient privileges, and corrupts or extracts research records. Permanent loss also requires unavailable or compromised recovery copies. R-08 / TVA-08 / A-02 Status: Local controls verified; production recovery pending
threats.mitigation: Loopback database binding, separate roles and actual synthetic restore test; immutable offsite recovery remains proposed. ACL-08 / SEC-08

threats.title: THREAT-11 Unattributable record changes
threats.description: An editor changes a research stage then denies doing it; writable or missing logs prevent reliable reconstruction. R-11 / TVA-11 / A-07; A-02 Status: Local grant controls verified; immutable external logging proposed
threats.mitigation: Server-derived audit actors and runtime INSERT/SELECT-only grants; administrator can still alter history. ACL-11 / SEC-11

threats.title: THREAT-03 Public private-data export
threats.description: An operator accidentally publishes a research export. Anyone with its URL can obtain nonpublic records; encryption at rest does not stop an authorized public read. R-03 / TVA-03 / A-02 Status: Proposed cloud extension; no public export route
threats.mitigation: Local temporary backup only. Cloud public-access blocking and expiring download controls remain proposed. ACL-03 / SEC-03

threats.title: THREAT-04 Committed credentials
threats.description: A repository reader obtains a secret and impersonates a service if network access and credential permissions permit. Removing the file alone does not revoke a leaked secret. R-04 / TVA-04 / A-05; A-02 Status: Implemented controls; owner-authorized merge exception is not peer review
threats.mitigation: Pre-commit rejection, Gitleaks CI and protected branches; rotate any real leaked credential. Native private-repo push protection unavailable. ACL-04 / SEC-04

threats.title: THREAT-06 Session interception
threats.description: A victim uses an insecure session path and an observer obtains a usable session. Ordinary Wi-Fi visibility does not decrypt correctly validated HTTPS. R-06 / TVA-06 / A-01; A-02 Status: Production transport protection pending
threats.mitigation: Hashed expiring bearer sessions and revocation; local HTTP only. Production HTTPS remains required. No cookie authentication. ACL-06 / SEC-06
